# commit-log-release-notes

Turns a list of commit messages you paste in into Markdown release notes grouped into breaking changes, features and fixes.

You paste a list of commit messages and get Markdown release notes back, grouped into Breaking Changes, Features and Fixes, with an extra Other Changes section for developer-only churn. It works only from the text you give it: no repository, no git, no network, and it rewrites terse log lines into bullets aimed at users rather than committers. The result arrives as report release-notes.md and inline.

Drafted by the Drafter (`agentry draft`). Review the manifest, the instructions and this file before you publish;
this README renders on the QuickAgent's page.
